lead_raw_text:
The structure of InN crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 8 atoms (In₄N₄) and 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis shows both In and N centers in tetrahedral coordination with four of the other element at neighbor distances of 2.3395–2.3451 Å, and the neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-sharing between In tetrahedra, between N tetrahedra, and between In–N tetrahedra.
